logp.method_description: The water-octanol partition coefficient of the complexes was determined using the shake flash method [26]. Each complex was added to an equal volume mixture of water (750 μL) and octanol (750 μL) under shaking for 24 h at 1000 rpm and 300K. Samples were centrifuged for 5 min at 500 rpm, and the organic and aqueous phases were separated. UV–Vis measured the drug concentration in each phase to determine P values using the formula Log P = log(Co/Cw), where Co and Cw are the molar concentrations of the complex in octanol and water, respectively.
